title: BB-8 Follows Rey Home
description: Now that the Droid is free, Rey looks down at him curiously. "Where'd you come from?" she asks. BB-8 beeps in response. Rey shows the Droid how to get to Niima Outpost, then turns back towards the AT-AT. BB-8 beeps pitifully. Rey looks around at the vast desert and the setting sun. She sighs and gestures for him to follow her.
